description.value:
This large wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is alive with creeping vines and mossy growths that shift in the air almost imperceptibly.

Activate—Grasping Vines f (concentrate, plant)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You use the verdant buckler to Shield Block a melee Strike

Effect The attacking creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] by the shield's animated vines (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained] on a critical failure). The affected creature is grappled or restrained for 1 round, until it [[/act escape dc=24]]{Escapes}, or you move, whichever comes first.
